cases.title: User Registration - Valid Credentials
cases.expected: HTTP 201, User registered, JWT tokens generated

cases.title: User Registration - Password Mismatch Validation
cases.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request with confirm_password error

cases.title: User Registration - Duplicate Email Rejection
cases.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request, email already exists
cases.actual: HTTP 400, Error: {'email': ['user with this email already exists.']}

cases.title: User Login - Valid Credentials
cases.expected: HTTP 200 OK, JWT access & refresh tokens returned

cases.title: User Login - Invalid Password Handling
cases.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized, 'Invalid email or password.'
cases.actual: HTTP 401, Detail: Invalid email or password.

cases.title: JWT Authentication - Token Refresh
cases.expected: HTTP 200 OK, New JWT access token issued

cases.title: User Profile Endpoint (/api/auth/me/)
cases.expected: HTTP 200 OK, Profile name 'Harish S' & email 'harish@example.com'

cases.title: Security - Protected Endpoint Unauthenticated Access
cases.expected: HTTP 401 Unauthorized when Bearer token is missing

cases.title: Category Listing & Seed Verification
cases.expected: HTTP 200 OK, 5 categories with icons and hex colors

cases.title: Dashboard Summary KPI Metrics Baseline
cases.expected: HTTP 200, Income: ₹25,000, Expenses: ₹16,750, Savings: ₹8,250

cases.title: Financial Integrity - Savings Balance Invariant
cases.expected: Savings equals (Total Income - Total Expenses)

cases.title: Expense Overview Line Chart - Mon to Sun Curve
cases.expected: HTTP 200, 7 daily data points (Mon-Sun) with income & expenses

cases.title: Expense Overview Chart - Range Filtering
cases.expected: HTTP 200, 'last_month' returns 4 weeks, '6_months' returns 6 months

cases.title: Category Spending Donut Distribution (Percentages Sum = 100%)
cases.expected: HTTP 200, Total: ₹16,750, Categories sum to 100%

cases.title: Recent Transactions List (Limit=4) Chronology
cases.expected: HTTP 200, Exactly 4 recent transactions, latest first (Domino's)

cases.title: Add Transaction - Valid Expense Record
cases.expected: HTTP 201 Created, Transaction persisted with ID and formatted date

cases.title: Dynamic Reactive Recalculation of Totals & Savings
cases.expected: Total Expenses increases to ₹17,500 (+₹750), Savings drops to ₹7,500

cases.title: Add Transaction Validation - Negative/Zero Amount Rejection
cases.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request, 'Amount must be greater than zero.'
cases.actual: HTTP 400, Error: {'amount': ['Amount must be greater than zero.']}

cases.title: Transaction Deletion & Baseline Reversion
cases.expected: HTTP 204 No Content, Expenses restored to ₹16,750, Savings to ₹8,250

cases.title: Unified Merged Link & Asset Bundling Delivery
cases.expected: HTTP 200 OK for HTML and bundled JS/CSS on merged port 8000
cases.actual: HTML Status: 200, Assets Verified: True (2 assets found)
